title: OpenBody
description: Symmetric identity, liveness, receive, route, path, hop, and transit offer.

x-agp.mechanics: Symmetric identity, liveness, receive, route, path, hop, and transit offer.
x-agp.rationale: A sovereign contract gives validators and consumers one stable reasoning boundary.
x-agp.consequence: Accepting another shape would make peer interpretation or ownership ambiguous.

nodeId.description: Identity claimed by the sending node.

sessionId.description: Pair-scoped identifier issued by this controller.

holdTimeMs.description: Offered hold timer in milliseconds; zero disables protocol hold expiry.

receiveLimitBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes accepted in one AGP packet.

maxRoutesPerSnapshot.description: Maximum route records accepted in one full snapshot.

maxPathLength.description: Maximum complete path length after this receiver appends itself.

maxDataHopLimit.description: Maximum data hop-limit value accepted from this peer.

bytes.description: Bytes the grantor will accept before further grant.

packets.description: Packets the grantor will accept before further grant.

initialCredit.description: Initial receive credit offered to the peer. Absent means this node does not enforce credit and accepts an unlimited peer.

transit.description: Whether this node may export learned routes and forward nonlocal data.
